question: A koala poster uses one large image and four short facts. An encyclopaedia page uses sections and more detail. Why might the poster suit a hallway display?

visual.alt_text: Three-step Comparing Texts on the Same Topic organiser. Read: animal poster and encyclopaedia. Notice: Find shared information. Choose the response supported by the example.

answers.text: Its many detailed sections suit a long research task.
